notAnIdeology.explanation: Wikipedia opens: "New Imperialism characterizes a period of colonial expansion primarily by the major Western powers as well as the Empire of Japan, during the late 19th and early 20th centuries", and Wikidata describes it the same way ("period of colonial expansion"). It is a historical era of conquest by many states with differing aims, not one set of political ideas; the ideas involved are audited separately (imperialism, colonialism, anti-imperialism).
